message: 25F. I got my STI panel results in the portal and I don't understand what one of the values means. Can someone explain?

output.reason: Patient is requesting clarification of test results, not reporting symptoms or a clinical problem.

Patient asks for interpretation of a specific value on her own STI panel result; a clinician needs to review the actual report to explain it and advise on any follow-up. No reported symptoms or time-critical features, so standard async review is appropriate.
output.patientMessage: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your results in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target. Explaining a specific value safely means looking at the actual report and what test it came from, so a general answer could mislead you. Please share the test name and result wording. If you develop new symptoms such as genital sores, unusual discharge, pelvic or belly pain, or fever, arrange clinical assessment rather than waiting for a reply.
